sources.snippet: The surfaces make query-key-dependent value routing explicit, a distinct mechanism from latent semantic manifolds studied in language-model representations. The learned surface maps query and key coordinates to a value-modulation gain. Its explicit geometry is the basis for visualizing and editing attention manifolds.
